exposure: Breastfeeding status (any vs none, >= 6 months vs none)
cohort: The study included N = 2610 cases with childhood brain tumors and N = 8128 age- and sex-matched controls from the Childhood Cancer and Leukemia International Consortium.
finding: Breastfeeding was not associated with an increased or decreased risk of childhood brain tumors, astrocytoma, medulloblastoma/PNET, or ependymoma.
birth_weight: Birthweight was adjusted for in the statistical models, but specific weights of the cohort are not mentioned.
